testo: Hi, I'm Leo, the tech guy of the team! I wanted to remind you of a neat trick for when you consume products. When loading pantry items, you only think about full packages; the magic of the slider cylinder comes into play during Unloading! If you use a fraction of a product (like half a bag of flour or a bit of milk), just move the slider to deduct the exact portion from the total while the app keeps the rest in memory. Your pantry stays accurate to the millimeter!
